sources.version: CSS Fonts Module Level 4 Working Draft
sources.notes: Generic families provide fallback categories; named local fonts are platform-dependent and never guaranteed.

assumptions: Named fonts may or may not exist on the visitor’s operating system; the final generic family is the only portable category guarantee.
licensing_data_restrictions: No user content is transmitted by normal tool execution. Third-party libraries retain their upstream licenses; font/PDF licensing remains the user’s responsibility.
uncertainty: “Web-safe” is probabilistic for named local fonts. Rendering metrics and glyph coverage vary by platform and version.
